query:
SELECT
             (SELECT count(*) FROM fms.assets c
               WHERE c.parent_asset_id = $1 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL)
               AS "children!",
             (SELECT count(*) FROM fms.work_orders w
               WHERE w.asset_id = $1
                 AND w.status NOT IN ('CLOSED','CANCELLED','REJECTED'))
               AS "open_work_orders!"
